summary: Thin forwarding wrapper: returns NhMalloc(a1, 1) where a1 is the requested byte size and 1 is a fixed second argument. The legacy ABI label identifies it as operator new. Called from hundreds of allocation sites across the game (mesh, camera, physics buffer, linked-list node, network packet, string and texture allocations), including operator-new-style callers such as OperatorNewWithResultCheck.
unresolved: Meaning of the fixed second argument 1 passed to NhMalloc (allocation tag or zero-init flag) is unknown.
Relationship to the legacy 'operator_new' ABI label is unconfirmed by the raw source.
Owner object is not applicable or unknown; the function is a free __cdecl wrapper.
